issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: flowering_azalea_leaves, stone_brick_wall, allium, cornflower, oxeye_daisy, dandelion, azure_bluet, lectern, bookshelf, chiseled_stone_bricks, vine, candle, red_wall_banner, brick_stairs, dark_oak_slab, light_weighted_pressure_plate, dark_oak_fence.
553 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: Automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm (see L2).
notes.scale: The 'walled garden' is a back wall plus loose pillars: from above and in the iso it reads as scattered posts, not an enclosed garden.
notes.artefacts: The obelisk (x13 z10) is capped with a flat gold pressure plate that reads as a yellow tile stuck on top; broken slab path from L1 remains.
notes.levels: Visibly different: garden pillars with lanterns, obelisk, azalea bushes, vines, candles.

visual.summary: Adds a garden with stone brick lantern pillars, an obelisk, azalea bushes, vines, pots and candles around the L2 manor.
problems: Walled garden is not walled: only the back wall (stone_brick_wall y0 x11..14 z12) exists; close the outer side x15 z3..11 and the front edge between the pillars with low stone brick walls, leaving a gate where the path enters.
Obelisk top: light_weighted_pressure_plate at (13,4,10) looks like a flat yellow tile: use a lantern, a stone brick wall tip or a small point instead.
Garden path still joins only at corners (cobblestone slabs y0, x10..13 z1..9): make it continuous.
Reach: 187 of 291 reached; unreached are roof slopes, eaves, the balcony floor and the tops of three garden pillars: fine.
